description: This file contains the implementation of the ReturnAction model class within the Opencart Admin Localization namespace. It provides methods to manage return actions, including adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving return action data and descriptions.

classes.name: ReturnAction
classes.description: Model class for managing return action data within the localization namespace of the Opencart admin module.

methods.name: addReturnAction
methods.description: Adds a new return action, inserting descriptions for multiple languages, and returns the new return action ID.

methods.name: editReturnAction
methods.description: Updates an existing return action by its ID and its language descriptions.

methods.name: deleteReturnAction
methods.description: Deletes a return action by its ID from the database.

methods.name: deleteReturnActionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all return action descriptions associated with a specific language ID.

methods.name: getReturnAction
methods.description: Retrieves a specific return action's data for the current language.

methods.name: getReturnActions
methods.description: Retrieves a list of return actions, with optional sorting and pagination.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all language-specific descriptions for a particular return action.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves all return action descriptions for a specific language ID.

methods.name: getTotalReturnActions
methods.description: Returns the total number of return actions for the current language.
